message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build and test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build and test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@master

      - name: Setup Node.js 24
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Build check
        run: npm run build:check

      - name: Build packages
        run: npm run build:test

      - name: Test
        run: npm test -- -i

      - name: Check size
        run: npm run check-size

      - name: Test performance
        run: npm -w mobx run test:performance",
  "rationale": "The repository uses npm ci on every run and has a committed package-lock.json, but the setup-node step does not enable dependency caching. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) applies: repeated dependency fetching is measurable, and cache inputs include the lockfile and Node environment. Adding cache: npm to actions/setup-node@v7 caches the npm dependency download state keyed on the lockfile, preserving every existing build, lint, typecheck, and test step with no coverage loss and no new privileges, secrets, or network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

- on: push (branches: [main]), pull_request (branches: [main]), workflow_dispatch

      - Install Dependencies: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - Lint: npm run lint
      - Build check: npm run build:check
      - Build packages: npm run build:test
      - Test: npm test -- -i
      - Check size: npm run check-size
      - Test performance: npm -w mobx run test:performance

Evidence patterns available:
1. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE - Cache dependency downloads. Preconditions: Repeated dependency fetching is measurable, Cache inputs include lockfile and environment. The repo has package-lock.json and package.json. The setup-node step doesn't use cache: npm. This is a good candidate - adding cache: npm to setup-node would cache node_modules.

2. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT - Bound jobs with custom timeout. Evidence shows elapsed savings of 26.8% in one experiment. But we don't know if valid slow runs exceed the limit.

3. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST - Matrix fail-fast. Not applicable - no matrix.

4. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE - Cancel superseded runs. Not directly a workflow change in the same way.

5. P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE - Share cached build dependencies. Requires trusted cache infrastructure.

The best fit is P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads). The repository has package-lock.json (lockfile exists), uses npm ci, and setup-node@v7 without cache. Adding `cache: npm` to the setup-node step is a minimal, safe change that preserves all build and test coverage.
